left.title: Hurricane Florence catastrophic flooding, rescues, and deaths: what we know
left.body: As of Saturday afternoon, more than 35 inches of rain had fallen in Surf City on the North Carolina coast. That’s an enormous amount of water to fall in two days. And more is on the way.
left.roundup: Hurricane Florence has claimed eight lives (with some media outlets reporting seven), caused massive flooding and left 900,000 homes without power.

center.title: 'Uninvited brute' Florence leaves 8 dead, nearly 1 million without power
center.body: A weakened Florence slowed to a crawl over South Carolina on Saturday as it began a slow trek to the west but continued to batter the region with storms surges and heavy flooding from as much as 15 more inches of rain.
center.roundup: Hurricane Florence has claimed eight lives (with some media outlets reporting seven), caused massive flooding and left 900,000 homes without power.

right.title: Slow-moving Tropical Storm Florence claims at least 7 lives in Carolinas as rainfall continues
right.body: Officials in South Carolina confirmed the state’s first fatality from the still dangerous Tropical Storm Florence, bringing the storm’s total death toll to at least seven so far.
right.roundup: Hurricane Florence has claimed eight lives (with some media outlets reporting seven), caused massive flooding and left 900,000 homes without power.
